message: 終わりと始まり

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is it... over...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The power of Re-Crea is fading away...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems the Demon Lord's power won out...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「Why... did you all... for me...」

name: Ria
message: 「That's easy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It wouldn't be any fun if someone was left out, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because you're a precious friend to us, Azel.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「We could never just leave you behind.」

name: Macaron
message: 「After all, that's what a sparkling school life is all about!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's silly and just like Sakura-kun, but... still, it's wonderful, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I want you to join that circle too, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「Over something like... just that alone...」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no need to overthink it」

name: Macaron
message: 「Let's take our time and get closer from here on out!」

name: Azel
message: 「Is someone like me really okay...?」

name: Azel
message: 「Even someone like me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course」

name: Macaron
message: 「We welcome you!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Thank you」
Her cheeks softly relax, and she closes her eyes.
I was finally able to see Azel smile from the bottom of her heart.

name: Melilot
message: 「...It seems she has fallen asleep」

name: Riesling
message: 「I shall escort her back to her room in the dormitory」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please take care of her, Jeeves」

name: Helena
message: 「Everyone accepting Azel, huh. Not bad at all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I guess Synn's stupidity rubbed off on us too」

name: Ria
message: 「A dummy, huh? That sure is troublesome\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Seriously, it really is. Just what are you going to do about it」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, he is my big brother, so it can't be helped!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, that makes me sound pretty bad...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like someone's been waiting for you」

name: Bylous
message: 「Heh... hahaha...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Just as I thought, your power is the real deal...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Now, fight me! Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous, you...」
Do I really have no choice but to fight?
What's even the point of a contest of strength like this...

name: Macaron
message: 「Hooold it right there!」

name: Bylous
message: 「...You again」

name: Bylous
message: 「Begone. I have no business with anyone other than the Demon Lord」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then neither of us has a problem, right!」

name: Bylous
message: 「What...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Right now, I'm... we're the Demon Lord together!」

name: Synn
message: 「On that point alone, I won't back down no matter what you say」

name: Bylous
message: 「What is the meaning of this... No, wait--this magical power...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Haven't you noticed, Bylous?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Witch...」

name: Melilot
message: 「In the short time leading up to Re-Crea, Macaron has grown at an astonishing pace」

name: Melilot
message: 「Having witnessed the battle just now, you must realize that as well」

name: Bylous
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Bylous
message: 「I'll admit that much, certainly」

name: Bylous
message: 「However, that alone is no reason to claim the title of Demon Lord」

name: Melilot
message: 「Perhaps so」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, what if Sakura isn't the only one of the bloodline entitled to bear the name of Demon Lord...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, what the hell are you talking about... Don't tell me you...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It caught my interest, so I took the liberty of looking into various things...」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, that is beside the point right now」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Above all else, the strength of the two standing right before you」

name: Melilot
message: 「Isn't that the very thing you seek as a Demon Lord?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Hmph...

name: Bylous
message: 「Indeed, so it was...

name: Bylous
message: 「As you two are now, you are more than worthy opponents!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You two have no objections either, I presume?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm~... I don't really get all that complicated stuff, and...

name: Macaron
message: 「Anyway, I just can't stand leaving things on a loss!」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's to become a proper Demon Lord together with Macaron...」

name: Synn
message: 「That will be my reason to fight!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Good, so you've finally found your resolve!」

name: Macaron
message: 「This time, I definitely won't lose!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll finish this right now!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Now come at me! You two Demon Lords!!」
